title: 師匠の教え
restoration: 原画の切り出し・規格内の紙色補正（拡大・反転なし）

tasks.script: RIGHT: Hajime has been earnestly studying a tower of notes and a laptop late after closing in tonari, eyes tired, asking his mentor 「勝つコツは？」 Sumi, newsboy cap, glasses, beard and brown waist apron, looks thoughtful and serious. LEFT: Sumi gently closes the laptop, slides a warm mug to him and points toward the door home, saying 「まず、寝ろ。」 Hajime finally notices he has been nodding off, relaxes and says 「はい。」 Warm comic ending. No smoking equipment needed, varied Turkish mosaic lamps in background, no identical generic plants.

known_deviations: 選別用の復刻候補。ゲームへの登録・採用画像の置換はしていない。
旧作の台詞数・看板文字・人物数などを保存。新作の2人/3台詞の制作ルールと異なる話は、正式採用前に編集確認が必要。
